About
Builder. Operator. Owner.

I don't manage what exists. I build what's needed — then scale it until the numbers move.

At Maruti Suzuki, I ran dealer network expansion across 9 states — 35+ projects, ₹150 Cr+ in investments, 18 new retail outlets generating ₹72 Cr/month in incremental business.

At Paytm, I launched a service channel that didn't exist, scaled it 12x, automated the reporting, built the governance, and managed the budget — all simultaneously. That's what I mean by ownership.

National Soundbox Service Channel

Impact
6x ticket capacity · Resolution 10%→70% · 250→3,000 agents

How I Work
The Operating Framework
Step 01
Understand the bottleneck
I start with the constraint — not the symptom. Whether it's a reporting lag, a retention drop, or a hiring bottleneck, I trace it to root cause before touching a solution.
Step 02
Build the system
Processes that run on heroics don't scale. I design frameworks, workflows, and tools that operate independently of any one person — including me.
Step 03
Create accountability
Every metric needs an owner. I establish KPIs, review cadences, and escalation paths that make performance visible and responsibility clear at every level.
Step 04
Scale through data
Growth decisions should be obvious, not argued. I build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that makes the next call easy — and the right one.
